title: Product Support Analyst – GCP & Data Delivery
description:
### 🏢 ABOUT EQUIFAX
Equifax is a global data, analytics, and technology company. We believe knowledge drives progress, blending unique data, analytics, and technology with a passion for serving customers and clients worldwide.

### 💼 SYNOPSIS OF THE ROLE
Ready to work on the front lines of data delivery, leveraging the power of **Google Cloud**? If you are a detail-oriented problem-solver who enjoys working with sophisticated cloud technology and contributing to a mission-critical platform, this role is for you!

As a **Product Support Analyst** within the Technical Fulfillment team, you will configure, operate, and monitor our high-volume batch data delivery platform built on Google Cloud. You will play a key role in processing and enriching financial data for clients, ensuring seamless and precise execution with high reliability.

### 🛠️ WHAT YOU WILL DO
- **Platform Configuration & Operation:** Configure and execute data processing workflows on the batch delivery platform according to established procedures and client specifications.
- **Data Pipelines:** Deploy and manage complex data pipelines orchestrated via **Apache Airflow**.
- **DAG Templates:** Leverage and extend Standard Airflow DAG Templates to ensure deployment consistency and rapid iteration across environments.
- **Monitoring & Quality:** Monitor data processing jobs, perform data quality checks, and diagnose/resolve configuration, scheduling, and dependency issues on GCP.
- **Security & SDLC:** Follow SDLC guidelines and strict enterprise security protocols for all configuration deployments.
- **Client Fulfillment:** Support cross-functional partners (Engineering & Data Operations) in addressing fulfillment-related inquiries and optimizing delivery processes.

### 🎓 WHAT EXPERIENCE YOU NEED
- **Education:** Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent.
- Strong analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive approach to problem solving.
- Familiarity with data processing concepts and batch delivery systems.
- Experience working with configuration files (e.g., **YAML**).
- Understanding of cloud computing concepts, ideally with exposure to **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
- Experience with **API testing tools** for inspecting data interfaces.
- Basic scripting skills (Shell / Bash / Python).

### 🌟 WHAT SETS YOU APART
- Experience with GCP services such as **Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Google Cloud Storage, or BigQuery**.
- Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools (Google Cloud Logging and Monitoring).
- Proficiency in Python scripting or Java.
- Ability to verify issues by testing in higher environments and support production incidents when needed.

### 📍 LOCATION & JOB DETAILS
- **Job ID:** J00178780
- **Workplace Location:** IND-Pune-Equifax Analytics-PEC, Pune, Maharashtra – 411014
- **Employment Type:** Full-time, Regular

### 🔗 HOW TO APPLY
Click the **Apply Directly** button to submit your application on the official Equifax Careers portal.
